mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair tramadol metabolism and increase seizure risk; tramadol also lowers seizure threshold in setting of metabolic derangements.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and seizure activity closely; consider alternative analgesia if possible; maintain aggressive hydration and electrolyte supplementation during amphotericin B therapy.
